current.description: First stable release of Canopy. Focuses on HPE ProLiant Gen11 support, adds the Gen11 CHIF interface, updates the OpenBMC base and fixes the issues found during 2026.04-rc2 testing.

upcoming.description: Next release with further HPE ProLiant Gen11 work and an upstream rebase to a more recent OpenBMC. Release candidates are available; 2026.12 is planned as the next LTS.

items.description: Second release candidate for 2026.06, adding OpenBMC and HPE ProLiant Gen11 features along with Gen11 bugfixes. Introduces breaking changes for Gen11 platforms: updating from an earlier release requires a full update via the static.mtd.all.tar archive.
First release candidate for 2026.06. Introduces breaking changes for HPE ProLiant Gen11 platforms, requiring a full update via the static.mtd.all.tar archive.
First stable release of Canopy. Focuses on HPE ProLiant Gen11 support, adds the Gen11 CHIF interface, updates the OpenBMC base and fixes the issues found during 2026.04-rc2 testing.
Second release candidate for the first Canopy release. Addresses the issues found during 2026.04-rc1 testing and updates the OpenBMC base.
Release candidate for HPE ProLiant Gen11 platforms. Source-only release for early adopters and evaluation.
First LTS release of Canopy with validated hardware support for AST2500 and AST2600 EVBs. Maintained on the LTS/2025.08 branch.
First beta release of Canopy with core BMC functionality. Not yet validated on hardware.
